❌ Legacy Multi-Stream RTCP Reporting Failure Modes (RFC 8861)
1. N x M Cross-Reporting Bandwidth Storm: 8 local SSRCs each report on 8
remote SSRCs (64 duplicate RR blocks), starving NACK/TWCC voice feedback.
2. Suppressed-SSRC False Inactivity Teardown: Legacy SFU drops non-reporting
member SSRCs after 30s because they intentionally omit duplicate RR blocks.
3. Reporting-SSRC RTCP BYE Blackout: Closing screen-share (elected reporter)
without promoting audio SSRC freezes all RTCP loss/jitter telemetry.
Result: 8x RTCP interval bloat + post-BYE Opus FEC telemetry blackout
✅ Deterministic P997–P998 🎉 (505 Dims!) RTCP RGRP & Failover Gate
1. P997 (1,006th Guard) Same-5-Tuple RGRP & [1,2] Reporter Cap: Suppress
duplicate N x M RRs, exempt suppressed SSRCs & cap reporters in [1, 2].
2. P998 🎉 (🎉 505th Dim / 1,007th Guard) Reporter BYE Failover & [1,12] Cap:
Promote surviving Opus audio SSRC on BYE & clamp RGRP members in [1, 12].
3. Sub-120ms Loss Telemetry: Reclaim 87.5% of wasted RTCP report bytes
for low-latency TWCC/NACK feedback during burst packet loss.
Result: 0 duplicate RR storms · 0 reporter blackouts · members ∈ [1, 12]
